Questions

What is the median annual wage for Chefs in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Chefs and Head Cooks in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $80,330.

What is the hourly median for Chefs in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Chefs and Head Cooks in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $38.62.

How many Chefs work in Seattle?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 3,740 wage-and-salary Chefs and Head Cooks in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Chefs in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.39. Values above 1.00 mean Chefs and Head Cooks are more concentrated in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Chefs in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Chefs and Head Cooks in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $76,820.

How does Seattle's Chefs median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Seattle's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($80,330) is $17,930 higher than Austin ($62,400) and $19,560 higher than Chicago ($60,770). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
